summary: You flambé a pan. How much of the alcohol burns off?

tiktok.text:
The flames look like they take it all. They do not. Answer and source in the video.

#cookingtips #foodscience #foodtok #recipefix

instagram_reel.text:
The flames look like they take it all. They do not. Answer and source in the video.

Answer: About 25%. USDA found about 75% of the alcohol is still there after flaming. Only about a quarter burns off.
Source: USDA Nutrient Retention Factors, Release 6

Save this before you cook with wine again.

#cookingtips #foodscience #foodtok #recipefix

youtube.title: You flambé a pan. How much of the alcohol burns off? #shorts
youtube.text:
Answer: About 25%. USDA found about 75% of the alcohol is still there after flaming. Only about a quarter burns off.
Source: USDA Nutrient Retention Factors, Release 6 (https://www.ars.usda.gov/ARSUserFiles/80400525/Data/retn/retn06.pdf)
